column1: # Keys somebody has already told us will differ, with the row that holds each one.
# THIS FILE SUPPRESSES NOTHING. An entry adds a sentence to the drift finding
# naming the row; it does not lower the severity, does not leave the drift
# count, and does not keep a run green. Its whole purpose is that a known
# difference should not read as a surprise to the next reader.
# The digest column is the digest the difference is expected to HAVE. A drift
# matching it is the one being held; a drift that does not match is a second,
# unrelated change, and renders.py says so loudly instead of letting one
# expectation cover everything that later happens to the same file.
# An entry whose key stops differing is reported as stale on the next run, so
# an expectation cannot outlive its cause. Drop the row when that happens.
# Columns are tab-separated: key, row, digest, who, date, note.
